_about: Expected labels and highlights for the guided demo's four scenario notes, which npm --prefix provider run measure checks first (the note text comes from src/data/guided-scenario.json). The other 96 benchmark cases are in scripts/gen-cases/generated-cases.json. `expected` is an authored synthetic reference, not clinician-validated; `highlight` is a substring of the sentence a reader expects highlighted, or null when no sentence gives a dose.
